Encode and decode Base64

Source: R/base64.R
base64_encode.Rd

base64_encode() writes bytes as Base64 text; base64_decode() reads it back.

Usage

base64_encode(x, url = FALSE, pad = TRUE, line_length = NULL)

base64_decode(x, url = FALSE, forgiving = TRUE)

Arguments

x

For base64_encode(), a raw vector, or a single string, which is encoded as its UTF-8 bytes. For base64_decode(), a single string or a raw vector holding the Base64 text.

url

Which alphabet: FALSE (the default) for the standard one with + and /, TRUE for the URL- and filename-safe one with - and _. base64_decode() also takes NA, which accepts either.

pad

Whether base64_encode() writes = padding.

line_length

NULL (the default) for one line, or a whole number of at least 4, one Base64 quantum: a line feed ("\n") is written after every line_length characters, as MIME and PEM do with 76 and 64. A value at least as long as the text gives one line. For the CRLF of MIME, use gsub() on the result.

forgiving

TRUE (the default) for WHATWG forgiving decoding, FALSE for strict RFC 4648; see Details.

Value

base64_encode(): a single string. base64_decode(): a raw vector. Input the chosen mode rejects raises a zuutf_base64_error whose offset is the 1-based position of the offending character.

Details

Decoding is forgiving by default, as the WHATWG "forgiving-base64 decode" is: ASCII whitespace (space, tab, line feed, form feed, carriage return) is skipped, padding is optional, and a final quantum of a single character is an error. forgiving = FALSE reads RFC 4648 section 3.3 strictly: padding is required, the unused bits of the last character must be zero, and whitespace is an error too. Padding is required with the URL alphabet as well, so text written with pad = FALSE decodes only in forgiving mode.

See also

zuutf_error for the condition classes.

Examples

base64_encode(charToRaw("hello"))
#> [1] "aGVsbG8="
base64_encode("hello", pad = FALSE)
#> [1] "aGVsbG8"
base64_encode(as.raw(c(0xfb, 0xff)), url = TRUE)
#> [1] "-_8="
base64_encode(as.raw(0:59), line_length = 64)
#> [1] "AAECAwQFBgcICQoLDA0ODxAREhMUFRYXGBkaGxwdHh8gISIjJCUmJygpKissLS4v\nMDEyMzQ1Njc4OTo7"

rawToChar(base64_decode("aGVsbG8="))
#> [1] "hello"
base64_decode(" aGVs bG8 ")              # whitespace is skipped
#> [1] 68 65 6c 6c 6f
base64_decode("-_8", url = TRUE)
#> [1] fb ff
base64_decode("+/8", url = NA)           # either alphabet
#> [1] fb ff
tryCatch(
  base64_decode("aGVsbG8", forgiving = FALSE),   # padding is required
  zuutf_base64_error = function(e) e$offset
)
#> [1] 7
